instruction.text: Wähle das richtige Wort für die Lücke aus.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_chirp'>I will thoroughly prepare for my job interview next week</voice>
atoms.b: I will thoroughly prepare for my job ((++interview entry qualification)) next week.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m4_2025'>My goal is to become a chef.</voice>
atoms.b: My ((++goal dream idea)) is to become a chef.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2_chirp'>I have turned in my cover letter and my CV in order to apply for the job.</voice>
atoms.b: I have turned in my  ((++cover_letter letter_of_recommendation certificates)) and my CV in order to apply for the job.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m14_chirp'>I received a placement in a law firm.</voice>
atoms.b: I received a ((++placement job position)) in a law firm.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f14_chirp'>There are so many details to remember when preparing your CV.</voice>
atoms.b: There are so many details to remember when preparing your ((++CV certificate application)).

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f8_chirp'>I want to find the job with the most days off.</voice>
atoms.b: I want to find the job with the most days ((++off in out)).

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f16Us'>I would prefer to work with others so that I will never have to spend my lunch break alone.</voice>
atoms.b: I would prefer to work with others so that I will never have to spend my ((++lunch breakfast dinner)) break alone.

instruction.text: Schreibe das fehlende Wort in die Lücke.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_chirp'>I hope my placement will help me decide if I want this job in the future.</voice>
atoms.b: I hope my ((placement)) will help me decide if I want this job in the future.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m5Us_chirp'>A good salary is important when you are looking for a job.</voice>
atoms.b: A good ((salary)) is important when you are looking for a job.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8Us_chirp'>People in many jobs have to work well with their colleagues.</voice>
atoms.b: People in many ((jobs)) have to work well with their colleagues.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f6Us_chirp'>Some employees have flexible working hours.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f13Us_chirp'>My boss explains our tasks before we start working.</voice>
atoms.b: My ((boss)) explains our tasks before we start working.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f6_2025'>You need good communication skills in many different jobs.</voice>
atoms.b: You need good ((communication)) skills in many different jobs.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f11_chirp'>I would like to gain more experience before choosing my career.</voice>
atoms.b: I would like to gain more ((experience)) before choosing my career.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m16_chirp'>A job interview can be stressful for young people.</voice>
atoms.b: A job ((interview)) can be stressful for young people.

atoms.text:
Du hörst gleich ein Gespräch zwischen Alex und seiner Mutter.

Vervollständige seinen Lebenslauf.
atoms.sound: Du hörst gleich ein Gespräch zwischen Ällex und seiner Mutter. Vervollständige seinen Lebenslauf.

instruction.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m11_chirp'>Hey Mum, could we have a look at my CV together and add some finishing touches?</voice><voice voiceLang='en' voice='f4_chirp'>Sure darling. Let's start with your education. Have you written down the name of your school there?</voice><voice voiceLang='en' voice='m11_chirp'>Yes, I have. I think I'm missing one subject for my predicted GCSEs though.</voice><voice voiceLang='en' voice='f4_chirp'>Ah, yes. Is it Art? </voice><voice voiceLang='en' voice='m11_chirp'>No mum, I no longer take Art. It's history.</voice><voice voiceLang='en' voice='f4_chirp'>Okay darling, be sure to add it then. Don't forget to mention that your attendance at school is almost at 100 percent, it means you're reliable.</voice><voice voiceLang='en' voice='m11_chirp'>Alright. Then lastly I will put that I play sports. I'm still so pleased that I switched from Basketball to Rugby last year.</voice><voice voiceLang='en' voice='f4_chirp'>Great. Let's take another look at the finished CV with your dad when he gets home.</voice>
